notes: Stop Live before starting the external-trigger sequence.
Nikon Eclipse Ti2 auto focus lock must be disabled for real Z-stack defocus.
Click Start in HCImageLive before running ni-ctrl scan.
With Mono: 1 Channel, one NI trigger saves one TIFF image.
For RGB Color: 2-Band, HCImageLive behaved as two NI triggers per saved TIFF during local testing.
